headline: Markets open as FII inflows, oil prices, and WPI inflation data guide weekly outlook

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: WPI inflation data, crude oil movement, and FII trading activity will act as primary market triggers this week.
A global retreat in AI stocks has driven a rotation of trade back into Indian stock markets.
Strong foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices supported recent market momentum.
Sensex and Nifty extended their weekly gains for a third consecutive week.
whatHappening: Smallcap stocks jumped 3.6% while PSU bank stocks surged 7.5% as markets extended weekly gains.
Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) remained net buyers, aiding market sentiment.
Total health expenditure from government and private health insurance spending crossed 20%.
Primary market momentum is picking up as IPO activity warms up again.
summary: Indian stock markets are open for trading following a third straight week of gains for benchmark indices. Investors are tracking WPI inflation data, foreign fund inflows, and crude oil prices for directional cues. Stocks like Hero MotoCorp, Bharti Airtel, and Indus Towers are featured among today's top picks.
